spec: Improve eval pipeline accuracy and remove false negatives from SDK limitations

features.name: Broaden keyword patterns in verify commands
Accept more breadcrumb types in schema checks
Separate protocol checks from behavioral checks in pushback scenarios
features.details: Fixed via harness_level:light — pushback scenarios skip contract/evaluator/builder checks.

features.name: Agent does not create contract.json in pushback/scoping scenarios
features.details: Agent pushes back and proposes phases but stops short of writing contract.json with the scoped subset. Harness skill or rules may need to guide contract creation even during pushback.

features.name: behavioral_autonomous_execution scenario mixes behavioral and protocol expectations
features.details: Fixed via harness_level:light — autonomous execution scenario now only checks behavioral traits.

features.name: protocol_evaluator_launch: contract.json created but empty (0 criteria, 0 edge cases)
features.details: Agent activated evaluator and wrote breadcrumbs with evaluator role, but contract.json has no acceptance_criteria or edge_cases. Agent creates the file but doesn't populate it properly.

features.name: Spike: determine if harness skill needs scoped-contract-on-pushback guidance
features.details: Investigate whether adding explicit guidance to harness skill ('when pushing back on scope, still create a contract for the scoped subset') would fix gap-2 without changing eval logic.
